item.title: Treading into record territory for our Tuesday with rising temperatures
item.description: The bottom line? Following a weekend cold front, high pressure reestablishes itself with a building ridge that will push daytime highs close to records again. Dry conditions prevail for the work week, but another cold front targets Northern Utah Thursday.
